entries.title: Psalms 41:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.>> Blessed [is] he who considers the poor; The LORD will deliver him in time of trouble.

entries.title: Psalms 41:2
segments: The LORD will preserve him and keep him alive, [And] he will be blessed on the earth; You will not deliver him to the will of his enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 41:3
segments: The LORD will strengthen him on his bed of illness; You will sustain him on his sickbed.

entries.title: Psalms 41:4
segments: I said, "LORD, be merciful to me; Heal my soul, for I have sinned against You."

entries.title: Psalms 41:5
segments: ¶My enemies speak evil of me: "When will he die, and his name perish?"

entries.title: Psalms 41:6
segments: And if he comes to see [me], he speaks lies; His heart gathers iniquity to itself; [When] he goes out, he tells [it].

entries.title: Psalms 41:7
segments: All who hate me whisper together against me; Against me they devise my hurt.

entries.title: Psalms 41:8
segments: "An evil disease," [they say], "clings to him. And [now] that he lies down, he will rise up no more."

entries.title: Psalms 41:9
segments: Even my own familiar friend in whom I trusted, Who ate my bread, Has lifted up [his] heel against me.

entries.title: Psalms 41:10
segments: But You, O LORD, be merciful to me, and raise me up, That I may repay them.

entries.title: Psalms 41:11
segments: By this I know that You are well pleased with me, Because my enemy does not triumph over me.

entries.title: Psalms 41:12
segments: As for me, You uphold me in my integrity, And set me before Your face forever.

entries.title: Psalms 41:13
segments: Blessed [be] the LORD God of Israel From everlasting to everlasting! Amen and Amen.
